task.subject: Ontology cross-pillar grant revocation kernel slice
task.description:
ChangeSet: cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-revocation-kernel-fd001-alignment
Owner: worker-3 only. You are not alone in the codebase; do not revert or overwrite worker-1/worker-2/root edits. Use the existing ontology worktree only if it is clean after task35; if not clean, report before editing.

Authority/context to load before editing:
- specs/root-hub-pointers.json, docs/AGENTS.md, specs/masterplan.json, specs/planning-closure-contract.json, specs/master-plan-sequencing.json, ADR-0217.
- microservices/ontology/IP-013-pillar-cross-pillar-grant.md and microservices/ontology/PHASE-01-TYPED-ENTITY-SUBSTRATE.md IP-013 row.
- Existing implementation/tests in crates/oya-ontology-kernel/src/pillar.rs: CrossPillarGrant issue/use, renewal, and audit issued/used/renewed/revoked/expired.

Owned write scope:
- crates/oya-ontology-kernel/src/pillar.rs
- exact task38 evidence under evidence/fd001/ and evidence/multispectrum/
No contracts, registry, Cargo/root, docs, or other crates.

Implementation target:
- Add a pure zero-I/O cross-pillar grant revocation decision surface that closes the lifecycle gap after task35: deterministic revocation request/value/error API, validation against the existing grant, revoker/reason/time checks, and a fail-closed use check when a revocation exists.
- Preserve clean-architecture kernel boundaries: no Cedar, DB, network, file IO, clocks, adapters, or handler logic.
- Reuse/align with existing CrossPillarGrantAuditEvent::revoked instead of duplicating audit semantics; extend it only if needed to consume the new revocation value safely.
- Tests must prove: valid revocation receipt; revocation before/at/after grant windows; empty revoker/reason; principal/self revoker refusal; wrong principal/source/target/data-class refusal; grant use before revocation still valid; grant use at/after revocation fails closed; audit revoked event maps the revocation details and retention/wire labels remain stable.

Verification required before lifecycle complete:
1. cargo fmt --all --check
2. cargo test -p oya-ontology-kernel -- --nocapture
3. cargo nextest run -p oya-ontology-kernel
4. cargo clippy -p oya-ontology-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings
5. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate planning-closure
6. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate data-class
7. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate architecture-boundaries
8. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate catalog
9. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate dependency-seam --evidence evidence/multispectrum/cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-revocation-kernel-fd001-alignment.json --emit-report evidence/fd001/cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-revocation-kernel-fd001-alignment-dependency-seam-report.json
10. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- git diff --check
11. Oya VCS claim/verify/done/promote for cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-revocation-kernel-fd001-alignment.
